coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: PKN Frontage Open Space (20th Street)
record.summary: The roughly half-acre '20th Street Plaza' of the D4D open-space network (Section 3.10), the landscaped entry plaza on Parcel K North's 20th Street frontage at Illinois Street, designed as the gateway from Dogpatch to the Historic Core with an entry plaza, seating terrace and planted garden. The Port's Parcel K North project lists a 20th St/Illinois St plaza among the buyer's obligations; no source found reports it built (the Port's Parcel K North page schedule stops at 2020-2021 design and permitting).

notes.accuracy_caveat: LOW-MODERATE CONFIDENCE -- Figure 3.3.1 is an illustrative, non-dimensioned rendering (no scale-accurate internal boundaries, unlike the D4D's own numbered-parcel figures), so this is a simplified bounding-box trace, not a precise outline. The D4D does name this space: Section 3.10 '20th Street Plaza' (approximately 0.5 acre, with its own Figures 3.10.1-3.10.5); this record's title 'PKN Frontage Open Space (20th Street)' is the earlier location-based placeholder and is kept only as its identifier. Its south/east/west edges match PKN's newly-retraced boundary (see the mapping log in the public data repository (https://github.com/pierandpoint/record)); its north edge is now ground-truthed against the real 20th St centerline (6.8m curb offset) rather than Figure 3.3.1's own illustrative depth, which turned out to extend past the real street entirely. Resulting strip is real but thin (~305 sq m) -- narrower than the diagram's own illustrative rendering implies.
notes.digitized_from: Pier 70 Design for Development, Figure 3.3.1 - Illustrative Open Space Plan (p.51).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: Open space with no Assessor lot of its own identified. The plaza is on the Illinois & 20th Street Parcel (Block 4110/Lot 001 per Port Item 9B), which Port Resolution 17-52 has the Port merge with a vacated piece of Michigan St and subdivide into four parcels including its own 'Plaza Parcel'; that parcel is outside Brookfield's 28-Acre Site, so the earlier statement that it lies within Brookfield's site is withdrawn. The Plaza Parcel's Assessor lot has not been checked.
notes.regulatory_context: Part of the Pier 70 D4D's Open Space Network: Section 3.10 '20th Street Plaza', approximately 0.5 acre, an entry plaza with a seating terrace and planted garden along Parcel K North's 20th Street frontage (Figures 3.10.1-3.10.5), shown on Figure 3.3.1 as landscaped open space. Port Item 9B (2017) lists the 20th Street Plaza among the infrastructure obligations retained for the adjacent Illinois Street Parcels.

facts.value: 3.10 '20th Street Plaza', zone 6 of the eight public open spaces in Figure 3.4.1

Entry plaza at 20th and Illinois (with interpretive signage and wayfinding, possibly a cafe along 20th Street), seating terrace and planted garden; illustrative section shows about 85 ft of entry plaza, a 51 ft planted garden and a 75 ft seating terrace between Illinois and Michigan Streets
'simple and not detract from the presence of Buildings 101 and 113-116'
Parcel K North buyer (TMG Partners / Presidio Bay Ventures) per the Port's project description of a 20th St/Illinois St plaza and Michigan Street improvements

open_questions: The D4D name '20th Street Plaza' is recorded in this record's map notes, but the record's title is still the placeholder 'PKN Frontage Open Space (20th Street)', which also serves as its identifier and page address; a rename has not yet been decided.

Whether the 'Plaza Parcel' created in 2017 was conveyed with Parcel K North or retained by the Port, and who will build the plaza if the PKN building stays unbuilt, is not stated in the retrieved documents.

No basis for an expected-completion date was found: this plaza is delivered by the Parcel K North buyer, whose own building has no target date (see the Parcel K North record's open questions), and no separate schedule for the plaza itself was found, so this record stays undated.
